column2: The Sire is located in the Abyssal Nexus, south of the Abyss used for Runecraft, and may be reached quickly using fairy ring dip.
column3: There are four chambers in the Nexus where a Sire can be found, allowing multiple people to fight the Sire per world, similar to Cerberus.
column4: Eyes at the entrance of each chamber can be peeked at to see if the Sire is being fought by another player.

column2: The Alchemical Hydra can be found in the lower level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon.
column3: Its lair is at the northern side of the dungeon, past the Tasakaal and then east past the hydras chamber.
column4: Orrvor quo Maten will be found guarding the entrance of the lair.
column5: Alternatively, with level 88 Agility the mysterious pipe shortcut just behind Kaal-Ket-Jor may be used to reach the lair safely.

column2: Amoxliatl is beyond a large door found to the west within the Ruins of Tapoyauik in Varlamore.
column3: By returning to the chamber with the Frost Nagua within Tapoyauik, players can use the lift platform in the centre (which appears after completion of the quest) to ascend to the Tower of Ascension.
column4: This unlocks a permanent shortcut which allows quick access to Amoxliatl.
column5: An ancient tablet by the pillar before the door shows statistics related to Amoxliatl.

column2: Araxxor's lair is accessible from the Morytania Spider Cave, with the cave itself being accessible via an entrance north-east of Darkmeyer.
column3: The lair can be entered via a web tunnel just north-west of the cave entrance.
column4: A scoreboard by the web tunnel shows statistics related to Araxxor.

column3: 2. (Blue, Green and Orange) Using the Mort'ton minigame teleport, Mort'ton teleport scroll and Morytania legs 3 & 4 are good alternatives to players who don't have access to the Barrows teleport.
column4: 3. (Pink and Light blue) Travelling using the Swamp Boaty is a valid method for ironmen who don't have access to abovementioned options.

column6: There are several different methods for travelling to the Barrows.
column7: The best options, ordered from fast to slow, are:
column8: Casting Barrows Teleport in the Arceuus spellbook (requires level 83 Magic), or using a Barrows teleport tablet or house portal to teleport right next to the entrance.
column9: Using the Mort'ton teleport scroll and then running east to Barrows.

column2: In the Taverley Dungeon, 2 black dragons spawn north-west near the Obelisk of Fire and can be safe-spotted behind the ladder, while 12 spawn in the upper level along with 5 baby black dragons.
column3: The ones in the upper level can only be killed when assigned black dragons as a Slayer task, otherwise the player will be stopped by Slieve if they attempt to attack them off-task.
column4: A dusty key or 70 Agility (80 if using the strange floor shortcut) is required to access the west side of the dungeon; the task-only area can be accessed by using the steps near the entrance.
column5: The Evil Chicken's Lair contains 4 black dragons.
column6: Killing them here requires starting Sir Amik Varze's subquest in Recipe for Disaster, and until the dragon token is redeemed, they will only drop it and these are 100% drops.
column7: Accessing this area requires a raw chicken offered to the chicken shrine in Zanaris.
column8: The dragon token is no longer obtainable after completing the subquest.
column9: The Corsair Cove Dungeon contains 2 black dragons.

column2: See also Mutated Bloodveld Locations and Bloodveld Safespots
Brutus can be found in the north-east corner of the cow field.
column3: By attempting to release him, the player is teleported into an empty, instanced version of the field, where Brutus will spawn.
column4: No other cows can be fought in this area, but it is possible to milk the dairy cows.

column2: There are 3 different rooms inside Cerberus' Lair in which Cerberus can be found.
The Chambers of Xeric are located on Mount Quidamortem, which can be quickly accessed via the Lovakengj Minecart Network.
column3: This costs 20 coins per ride unless the player has completed The Forsaken Tower, in which case it is free.
column4: Otherwise, players will need to head to the Shayziens' Wall and make their way west to Mount Quidamortem; be wary of aggressive lizardmen and lizardmen brutes.
column5: For those arriving there without the mine cart system, speak to the Mountain Guide (who is located on the mountain next to Gnosi, Historian Duffy, and the Natural Historian) before leaving; doing so will establish a two-way transportation system between the mountain and the Shayziens' Wall which can be accessed by using the book of the dead and use the History and Hearsay option, then run south-west.
column6: Once players receive an ancient tablet as a reward from the Chambers of Xeric, they are able to use it on Xeric's talisman to unlock a teleport directly to the mountain.
column7: The fairy ring BLS will bring the player near Mount Quidamortem.
column8: Run west, then take the path leading up the mountain in the north-west.

column2: The fastest way to reach the Chaos Fanatic is by casting Ghorrock Teleport or using its magic tablet equivalent.
column3: Alternatively, a burning amulet can teleport players to the entrance of the Lava Maze; run west from there.
column4: Alternatively, players with the hard Wilderness Diary completed and a POH obelisk can select the level 44 Wilderness teleport.

column2: The Corporeal Beast's Lair is located in level 21 Wilderness, although players can teleport directly there using a games necklace.
column3: This will take the player to a small safe room with a large doorway to Corporeal Beast.
column4: Ironmen with a combat level of 90 or higher have a separate Corporeal Beast room.
column5: All other accounts use the normal room.
column6: This is to reduce griefing as well as prevent ironmen from using normal accounts to use stat-reducing special attacks.

column2: The fastest way to get to the crazy archaeologist is by using the spell Dareeyak Teleport from the Ancient Magicks spellbook with 78 Magic or a Dareeyak teleport tablet.
column3: Alternatives include:
column4: Rub a burning amulet to teleport to the Bandit Camp, just east of the ruins.
column5: Cast Trollheim Teleport (61 Magic), and then use the agility shortcut (64 Agility) that connects to the Wilderness.
column6: The Cemetery Teleport (71 Magic) on the Arceuus spellbook is also quite close.

column2: The Dagannoth Kings reside in the sixth level of the Waterbirth Island Dungeon.
column3: Players will need to get past a series of doors and then run through several chambers of the dungeon to reach them.
column4: There are several methods to quickly getting to Waterbirth Island, with the Waterbirth Teleport from the Lunar spellbook, a portal (nexus) in a POH directed to the island, or using an enchanted lyre to teleport to the island directly (after completion of the Hard Fremennik Diary) being the fastest ways.
column5: Alternative ways to reach the island include teleporting to Rellekka with a Rellekka teleport tablet, an enchanted lyre or the Fremennik sea boots 2/3/4, and travelling there via Jarvald.
column6: Without stamina or super energy potions, it is recommended to pause at the following spots to restore run energy, as the trek is very long.
column7: Before entering the dungeon.
column8: Before using the rune thrownaxe's special attack.
column9: In any of the rooms where giant rock crabs are.

column2: The fastest way to reach the boss is to use a Digsite pendant to teleport to Fossil Island, then take the Mycelium Transportation System to the Sticky Swamp.
column3: An axe is required to chop a swamp vine in order to reach him.
column4: A rake is required for smaller vines only if traversing the entire swamp instead of taking the Mycelium.
column5: Directly before the area is a spine mushroom that will occasionally hit passing players for 10 damage and apply poison.

column2: Players can use a Mokhaiotl waystone to teleport to the Ruins of Mokhaiotl.
column3: Players can use Pendant of Ates and teleport to the Kastori waystone and then run north-west.
column4: Use a Quetzal whistle to fly to Tal Teklan, and then run east to the Tonali Cavern.
column5: Once inside the Crypt of Tonali, players can search the chest to the west of the lift platform to collect two ancient teleporters to place in the cavern and shorten the speed to get back to the boss.
column6: The teleporters must be placed within 30 tiles of each other.

column2: Ghorrock Prison is accessible from Ghorrock Dungeon, with the dungeon itself being accessible from Weiss's Salt Mine.
column3: Players do not have to traverse the entirety of Ghorrock Prison after the completion of the quest, as they will instead directly reach the asylum when going through the main prison entrance.
column4: A scoreboard by the gates leading to the asylum show statistics related to Duke Sucellus.

column2: As with all of Varlamore, the Fortis Colosseum requires completion of the quest Children of the Sun.
column3: Players can use the ring of dueling teleport to Fortis Colosseum. (requires 12,000 glory)
column4: Players can take a Quetzal to Fortis Colosseum and walk east.
column5: Players can use the Civitas illa Fortis Teleport requiring 54 Magic and completion of Twilight's Promise and walk south-east.
column6: Players can charter a ship to Civitas illa Fortis and walk south-east.

column2: The Giant Mole is accessed by digging with a spade on top of the mole hills in the Falador Park.
column3: A light source is required to navigate the tunnels without taking damage.
column4: Candles, torches, or oil lamps will be extinguished if it retreats within melee range.
column5: A tinderbox is needed to relight extinguished light sources.
column6: Completion of Making Friends With My Arm unlocks the ability to create the Fire of Eternal Light within the lair, which acts as a permanent unextinguishable light source in the tunnels.

column2: Lovakengj Minecart Network to Shayzien West brings you right next to the dungeon
column3: Kourend Castle Teleport or Xeric's talisman teleport to Xeric's Heart, enter the catacombs of Kourend, run west to the skeletons and climb the vine ladder.
column4: Fairy ring DJR and run south-west, by the coast.
column5: Just south of the dock, there is a cave.
column6: Kharedst's memoirs or Book of the Dead to 'History and Hearsay' Shayzien teleport, run south-west through the graveyard gate, then north-west.

column2: The Kalphite Queen resides in the Kalphite Lair south-west of the Shantay Pass.
column3: Two ropes are required to access the lair, one to enter the dungeon itself and another to reach the lower level where Kalphite Queen resides.
column4: A rope is consumed in process of entering the dungeon.
column5: Completion of the hard Desert Diary makes these ropes permanent once placed.
column6: With the completion of the elite Desert Diary, a crevice shortcut can be used with level 86 Agility.
column7: The shortcut connects the lair's entrance to the entrance of the lower level.
column8: Players with access to Dorgesh-Kaan can find a tunnel in the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon that leads through to the Kalphite Lair, emerging near the Kalphite workers.

column2: : The entrance to the King Black Dragon Lair (aka KBD Lair) is located in the Wilderness; watch out for player killers!
column3: Note: After climbing down the ladder near the lesser demons, players must pull a lever surrounded by poisonous spiders to access the lair.
column4: The burning amulet teleports the player to the Lava Maze just south-east of the fenced area containing the entrance to the lair.
column5: This is the fastest and most reliable method of getting there.
column6: Wilderness Obelisks can be used, but be wary that using them will make encountering high-level monsters or PKers more likely.
column7: Players who have completed the hard Wilderness Diary can choose the obelisk they wish to teleport to, namely the obelisk closest to the lair at level 44 Wilderness.
column8: The nearest obelisk can be accessed if the player teleports to the Corporeal Beast area via a games necklace, exits the cave, and runs south-east to the obelisk and then south-east again.
column9: From Edgeville, players can make a waka canoe (requires 57 Woodcutting) at the canoe station and take it to the Wilderness.

column2: The fairy ring code AKQ will bring the players just east of the Cove.
column3: Using a Piscatoris teleport scroll, or either the Western banner 3 or 4 to teleport the Piscatoris Fishing Colony, and running south-west.

column2: The Scar is an area of the Abyssal Space, accessed by talking to the Catalytic Guardian in the Temple of the Eye.
column3: To reach the Leviathan in the Scar, players must proceed east of the Abyssal Rift towards Wizard Persten's camp.
column4: A rowboat there can then be used to reach the island where the Leviathan is located.
column5: Climbing the handholds onto the platform initiates the fight momentarily.
column6: A scoreboard just before the rowboat shows statistics related to the Leviathan.

column2: Three shamans reside in the western area of Lizardman Canyon via the handholds.
column3: These three shamans are present in a multi-combat area.
column4: Shayzien soldiers will not attack the shamans (nor will the shamans attack them), since they are busy dealing with a small group of normal lizardmen.
column5: Below are a couple ways to get there.
column6: Players can check how many players are currently in the western area of the canyon by speaking to the wounded soldier outside the canyon, just south of the broken crossbow.
column7: : Be wary of more than one shaman attacking at a time as they can quickly stack up damage from their abilities and attacks, which can quickly end a trip.
column8: To avoid being attacked constantly by the nearby lizardmen and their brute forms, killing the ones in the north and south-west corners is recommended.
column9: Use Xeric's talisman to teleport to Xeric's Inferno.

column2: The Mad Angel is located in Ardeaglais, the cathedral found on the southern side of Wyrmscraig; the necklace of passage teleport to Wyrmscraig is located to the east, while the slayer ring can teleport to Wyrmscraig Cavern, a short distance away from the cathedral's basement.
Use Drakan's medallion to get to Castle Drakan, enter Vampyrium, and then run east.
column3: Before fighting the boss, players should unlock a quick-travel method by rescuing an aranei scout south-east of Sangvesti.
column4: This scout will initially be attacked by sanguidae; kill all three of them, then talk to the scout again, who will then be found south of the bank chest by the map icon and will take players just east of Sangvesti.
column5: Two agility shortcuts can be used to traverse the woods more quickly, both requiring level 64 Agility.
column6: Lastly, to use the bank chest, it must first be built with level 70 Construction (boosts can be used) using a hammer and saw, 1 magic stone, 2 cupronickel bars, 2 adamantite bars, and 4 ironwood planks.

column2: The giantsoul amulet can be used to teleport right outside Obor's lair.
The Phantom Muspah's lair is accessible from Ghorrock Dungeon, with the dungeon itself being accessible from Weiss's Salt Mine.
column3: The lair can be entered from a crevice south-west of the dungeon.
column4: A scoreboard by the crevice shows statistics related to the Phantom Muspah.

column2: The quickest methods of reaching Slepe, where The Nightmare resides, are:
column3: Teleporting to the Sisterhood Sanctuary via Drakan's medallion after the Slepey tablet has been acquired from Phosani's Nightmare
column4: Teleporting to Ver Sinhaza via Drakan's medallion, then running north.
column5: Once players pass the small dock, they can run east to arrive at Slepe.
column6: From there, the player can go down the stairs in the small building directly south of the graveyard, and then run east to arrive at the bridge to the Sisterhood Sanctuary.
column7: Teleporting to the Hallowed Sepulchre with a Hallowed crystal shard (can be purchased from Mysterious stranger for 1 Hallowed mark) after completion of Sins of the Father, then running to the shortcut on the east side of the city (requires 63 Agility and two long ropes to unlock).
column8: Players can then run east to Slepe, where they can go down the stairs as mentioned above.
column9: Using the Ectophial to teleport to the Ectofuntus, then heading north to the small dock and paying Andras 10,000 coins to row to Slepe.

column2: The Royal Titans can be accessed in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon (fairy ring code AIQ).
column3: The entrance tunnel to the bosses can be found in the western part of the dungeon.
column4: With level 60 Agility, a tunnel shortcut just west of the dungeon ladder can be used for faster access to the boss.
column5: Furthermore, a giantsoul amulet can instead be used to directly teleport outside of the bosses' entrance tunnel.
column6: A scoreboard by the tunnel shows statistics related to the Royal Titans.

column2: Sarachnis is located in the burial tomb in the southern-most part of the dungeon, reached via the entrance across the river to the east of the Forthos Ruin.
column3: Players will need a slash weapon or a knife to be able to pass through the webs that block access to where Sarachnis is located, unless using Aranea Boots.
column4: The same webs can be peeked through to see how many players are inside the tomb.
column5: The last thick webs that block access to the tomb do not need a slash weapon or a knife to be slashed through.

column2: Scurrius' lair is located within the Varrock Sewers, with the sewers being accessible via a manhole just east of Varrock Palace.
column3: The lair can be found east of the sewers entrance.
column4: Players can enter or leave the lair by climbing through the broken bars or by crossing through sewage water, respectively; there will be an approximately 15 second delay after leaving before being able to rejoin.

column2: The shellbane gryphon is located in a cave in the centre of the Great Conch, north of fairy ring CJQ.
There is a task-only area accessible via some icy steps by the exit to the wyvern area.
There are several ways of reaching Tempoross.
column3: You will need to board the boat at the sea spirit dock west of the Ruins of Unkah.
column4: Beware of desert heat while travelling there.
column5: These options, ordered from fastest to slowest, are:
column6: Taking Ferryman Sathwood's ferry south of the Al Kharid bank will take you straight to the destination
column7: Using the pharaoh's sceptre teleport to the Ancient Pyramid using the teleport option Jaldraocht and heading south-west.
column8: Using the Camulet to teleport to Enakhra's Temple Entrance and heading south.
column9: Taking the magic carpet to Menaphos and heading north-west.

column8: Players can then run east to Slepe, where they can go down the stairs as mentioned above.
column9: Using the Ectophial to teleport to the Ectofuntus, then heading north to the small dock and paying Andras 10,000 coins to row to Slepe.

column2: Drakan's medallion provides unlimited teleports directly to Ver Sinhaza.
column3: The medallion is locked behind the completion of A Taste of Hope quest.
column4: Players may pay 10,000 coins to Andras north of the Ectofuntus in Port Phasmatys to travel to Slepe, then run south from there.
column5: Players can also use an Ectophial to travel to the Ectofuntus and run south from there.
column6: After starting Darkness of Hallowvale, players can take the boat from Burgh de Rott to the Meiyerditch beach and walk to the Theatre without having to navigate through the city.

column3: The fairy ring code BKP will bring the players just south-west of the dungeon.

column2: The Stranglewood's Ritual Site is located north-west of the forest.
column3: The site can be accessed by climbing over rocks leading to it.
column4: After entering the Ritual Site once, a shortcut on the pathway north-west of the temple can be used to reach Vardorvis quicker.
column5: The fastest way to get to Vardorvis is the teleport to "The Stranglewood" on the ring of shadows, once it has been unlocked with the strangled tablet.
column6: Other fast options include the bls fairy ring or the Xeric's talisman (with the Xeric's Honour teleport to Mount Quidamortem unlocked), which both give quick access to the rowboat that connects the Kebos Lowlands to The Stranglewood.
column7: During Leagues, the League Navigator can transport players from Quetzacalli Gorge to the Stranglewood.

column2: Vorkath can be found on the island of Ungael, in the centre of its crater.
column3: The island is accessible by talking to Torfinn the sailor on the third dock from west in Rellekka.
column4: It can also be accessed via the "Ungael" option on Torfinn or the "Travel" option on his Fremennik boat after travelling to Ungael for the first time.
column5: Players can enter or exit the crater by climbing over ice chunks blocking the way.

column2: The Whisperer is initially seen as an Odd Figure just beneath the surface in the middle of the Lassar Undercity's sunken cathedral.
column3: The undercity is accessible from the sinkhole north-west of Ruins of Camdozaal, located under Ice Mountain.
column4: A scoreboard by the stairs leading down to the cathedral shows statistics related to the Whisperer.

column2: There are four main methods for travelling to the Wintertodt camp in order to enter the Doors of Dinh.
column3: These options, ordered from fast to slow, are:
column4: Players can reach the camp via games necklace, provided they have already taken Veos' ship to Great Kourend once.
column5: Players can choose the Northern Tundras option in the Lovakengj Minecart Network which brings them just south-east of Wintertodt.
column6: Players can use the fairy ring code CIS and walk west along the path, provided they have visited Great Kourend previously through some other means.
column7: Players can use the Arceuus Home Teleport by switching to the Arceuus spellbook by speaking with Tyss.
column8: This can be done with no requirements and is particularly useful for players who chose to start their Ironman accounts by training at Wintertodt, as there are few fast travel methods at low levels for iron accounts.
column9: There is a tent with a bank chest just east of the game necklace teleport location.

column2: The quickest methods of reaching the Chasm of Fire, where Yama resides, are:
column3: Using a chasm teleport scroll, which teleports the player next to the Voice of Yama
column4: Fairy ring code DJR then run north-west
column5: With 83 Agility, players can slide down a chain by the entrance, placing them next to the Voice of Yama
column6: With 73 Agility, players can use the platform edge north of the entrance, then jump gaps to get to the lift to the bottom floor
column7: History and Hearsay teleport on Kharedst's memoirs/Book of the Dead, then run north

column2: The fastest route to travel to Zalcano is by using a teleport crystal or its eternal counterpart.
column3: Other ways include using a spirit tree to Prifddinas or a teleport to house with your house location in Prifddinas or a scroll of redirection on a tablet.

column2: Zulrah is located at a shrine east of Zul-Andra.
column3: Players can quickly get here by:
column4: taking a charter ship to Port Tyras and then running south
column5: using the fairy ring code BJS to the small island west of Zul-Andra, and then leaping across the stepping stones (requires 76 Agility, can be boosted)
column6: using a Zul-andra teleport scroll
column7: All of these methods require completion of Regicide.
column8: Zulrah's Shrine is accessed by boarding the sacrificial boat.
column9: Upon entering the shrine, a still scene of the shrine will be shown with a prompted dialogue.
